name: @eregister/wit-grid-monorepo
description: Headless high-performance spreadsheet and grid engine

scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:demo && pnpm run build:site
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @eregister/wit-grid-core run build && pnpm --filter @eregister/wit-grid-react run build && pnpm --filter @eregister/wit-grid-examples run typecheck
scripts.docs:verify: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run docs:check && pnpm run docs:lint && pnpm run build:site
scripts.release:prepare-docs: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run docs:generate && pnpm run docs:release:from-package -- --force && pnpm run docs:verify
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @eregister/wit-grid-core run test && pnpm --filter @eregister/wit-grid-react run test
scripts.test:architecture: pnpm --filter @eregister/wit-grid-core exec vitest run src/boundary.test.ts src/engine/architectureGuards.test.ts && pnpm --filter @eregister/wit-grid-react exec vitest run src/boundary.test.tsx
scripts.test:adversarial: pnpm --filter @eregister/wit-grid-core exec vitest run src/rowModel.adversarial.test.ts src/lifecycle.adversarial.test.ts src/serverRowModel.adversarial.test.ts src/gridHost.adversarial.test.ts && pnpm --filter @eregister/wit-grid-react exec vitest run src/gridPortalStore.adversarial.test.ts
scripts.bench:long-session: pnpm --filter @eregister/wit-grid-core exec vitest run src/perf/longSessionResilience.test.ts && pnpm --filter @eregister/wit-grid-react exec vitest run src/gridPortalStore.adversarial.test.ts
scripts.verify:core: pnpm run typecheck:core && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint:core && pnpm --filter @eregister/wit-grid-core run test && pnpm run test:architecture && pnpm run test:adversarial && pnpm run api:check && pnpm run pack:verify
